about: The face's reshaping for every figure (#463, the 3D review's second round), laid on each figure's own landmarks by face-ops.py. Radii in mouth widths; s = across, up, depth; back in face widths; drop: how far below the slit, in mouth widths, the chin's pad is centred. Tuned on Vipasyin against the concept's ratios (face-ratios.py). fill: the hollow under the lower lip filled by k of its depth, radius r mouth widths. 2026-11-21 r6: mouth across 1.08 → 1.12 (the art director: about 1.2 times the nose's wings; both reviewers and the T05 lead asked for wider). r6 (the 3D review's third round): the mouth's depth moves with its own radius rd (2.3 w) and fades in from the base of the nose to the upper lip; across back to 1.08 (1.12 made the mouth 0.38 of the face); the chin's pad narrowed 0.9 across, its depth not pressed further; jaw: the jaw's line lifted d face widths either side, x mouth widths out, drop below the slit, radius r. Across 1.03: with the wider depth move the mouth measured 1.25–1.28 times the nose's wings at 1.08; 1.03 aims at about 1.2 (the art director, the T05 lead). r7 (the 3D review's fourth round): flatten — the lips' volume kept to k, radius r w, smoothed over sr w; philtrumPad — the pad between the nose and the lip likewise; facex — the lower face ×k across below the cheekbones (cheek: their height, as a share of the slit-to-brow span, above the slit), easing over fade of that span, out again by neck spans below the slit; groove — a groove depth w deep and width w wide along the slit as it was, dimples at the corners d w deep within r w. r7, revised the same day (the 3D review withdrew 'a real figure's lips are thin', which had no source, once the T05 lead described the photograph of the real figure): the aim is a calm face, not thinner lips — flatten k 0.6 takes down the frame of hollow round the lips but keeps their fullness and the slit; no groove; the lower face no narrower than 0.95. r7 with the art director's r6 review: mouth across 1.0 (back to the concept's proportion: the art director withdrew 'about 1.2 times the nose's wings'); the ridge under the nose pressed further (philtrum pad k 0.2, r 0.45 w); the fold under the lip half filled; the chin's pad wider (1.0 w across) so it runs into the cheeks. The lips' volume follows the 3D review (kept full, k 0.6, no groove): shape is the 3D review's to judge (skills/art-gate/SKILL.md §6).
